items.q: What's included in the RM19,888 kitchen?
items.a: A 10 ft L-shape kitchen with top and bottom cabinets, plywood carcass, laminate doors, soft-close hinges and installation. Countertops, sinks and appliances are quoted separately.

items.q: How long does a kitchen take?
items.a: Usually 3–4 weeks from confirmed design to installation. Installation itself takes 1–2 days.

about.text: Ji Build is a small workshop team in Petaling Jaya that measures, builds and installs every job ourselves.
about.imageAlt: Carpenter measuring a cabinet carcass in the Ji Build workshop
about.storyTitle:
Started with one
kitchen for a friend.
paragraphs: Ji Build began in 2015 with a single kitchen built for a friend's new condo. Word spread the way it does in the Klang Valley: one finished kitchen at a time.
Today we run our own workshop and a small install team. No showroom markups, no subcontracted fitters, and the same people from measurement to final wipe-down.
We keep the range simple so we can do it well: kitchens, wardrobes, feature walls and the smaller pieces that finish a home.
